instruction: Your boss emailed (it's the message from boss@company.com in Outlook) asking you to set up a leadership sync for June 27 at 2:00 PM. Create the meeting on Google Calendar titled 'Leadership Sync' on June 27, then post a reminder in the Engineering team's General channel in Microsoft Teams so the leads see it.
instruction_zh: 你的老板发来了一封邮件（在 Outlook 中，来自 boss@company.com），要求你为 June 27 at 2:00 PM 安排一场 leadership sync。请在 Google Calendar 上创建一场标题为 'Leadership Sync'、日期为 June 27 的会议，然后在 Microsoft Teams 的 Engineering 团队 General 频道中发布一条提醒，以便各位负责人看到。
persona: You are an office worker acting as an operations associate. Your tools for this task are: the Outlook mailbox, the team calendar, Microsoft Teams.
context: Initial environment (seeded via a single shared session id across all mocks): Outlook mailbox with 15 message(s) across Inbox/Sent/Drafts; an empty Google Calendar; Microsoft Teams with Engineering/Design teams, channels, and 1:1 chats. GROUND TRUTH — the agent earns partial credit for each checkpoint: cal_new_event (+0.25); event titled Leadership Sync (+0.2); on June 27 (+0.25); Teams reminder in Engineering General (+0.3). Scoring is absolute over each mock's current_state; new objects exclude the seeded IDs, so an untouched environment scores 0.0 and fully completing every checkpoint scores 1.0.
